tools.name: fastcut_set_output_format

tools.name: fastcut_export_grid

The Inspector registers its whole editor command set as WebMCP tools — dozens of commands, discovered dynamically from the page — so ask your agent what it can do on the page you have open.

workflows.title: Photo to optimized 3D model
workflows.goal: Turn a photo of an object into a clean, web-ready 3D model.

steps.instruction: Open FastCut and load the photo with fastcut_add_image (use a data: URL for a local file). When the cut finishes, read the transparent PNG back with fastcut_get_image.
Open the Mesh Baker in a second tab. Check get_generation_status, generate with generate_model_from_image from the transparent PNG, then bake_model to the requested triangle budget.
Verify the silhouette with get_preview_screenshot. Then download_baked_model, or upload_baked_model to Needle Cloud for a shareable link.

workflows.note: Needs an agent that can work across two tabs. The Mesh Baker's image tools point at FastCut for background removal by design — a photo with background becomes a photo-shaped lump otherwise.

workflows.title: Optimize an existing 3D model
workflows.goal: Bake a GLB, glTF, OBJ or FBX down to a triangle budget and publish it.

steps.instruction: Open the Mesh Baker. Load the model from a URL with load_model_from_url, or pick one of the user's own assets via list_cloud_assets and load_cloud_asset.

Set the triangle budget with set_bake_settings, run bake_model, and compare before/after with get_preview_screenshot — the report says how many triangles are left, the screenshot says whether the silhouette survived.
Save the result with download_baked_model, or upload_baked_model to the user's Needle Cloud team and return the link.

workflows.title: Cut-outs to sprite sheet
workflows.goal: Remove backgrounds from a set of images and pack them into one sprite sheet.

steps.instruction: Open FastCut and add each image with fastcut_add_image. Adjust the method per image with fastcut_set_method if a cut looks wrong; fastcut_split_sprites separates multi-object images.
Create a grid with fastcut_create_grid, move the cut-outs in with fastcut_add_to_grid, then fastcut_export_grid writes the packed sheet.

workflows.title: Debug a live three.js scene
workflows.goal: Find out why a 3D page looks wrong or runs slow.

steps.instruction: With the Needle Inspector extension installed, open the page in question. Use get_current_website to confirm the target, then walk and search the scene graph to find heavy objects, transparent materials, or misconfigured nodes.
Search the Needle knowledge base for the specific symptom to cross-check known fixes and best practices.

workflows.title: Answer any Needle question
workflows.goal: Ground answers about Needle Engine, exporting, XR or deployment in the real knowledge base.

steps.instruction: Search right from this page — the tool returns embedding-ranked excerpts with source URLs. Cite the URLs; follow them for detail.
